tools.name: kommo_get_account
tools.description: Get the Kommo account: id, subdomain, country, currency and the current user id. Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /api/v4/account.

tools.name: kommo_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the lead pipelines with their stages (status ids, names, sort order). Use it to find the pipeline_id and status_id values for lead filters and writes. GET /api/v4/leads/pipelines.

tools.name: kommo_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the account with their ids, names, emails and roles. Use it to find responsible_user_id values. GET /api/v4/users.

tools.name: kommo_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of leads, contacts or companies (ids, names, types, enum options). Use it to find field ids before writing values. GET /api/v4/{entity}/custom_fields.

tools.name: kommo_list_leads
tools.description: List deals (leads) with price, stage, pipeline, responsible user and timestamps. Filter by text, pipeline, owner or the update window. One request per call. GET /api/v4/leads.

tools.name: kommo_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead by id, with optional embedded data (contacts, loss_reason, source). GET /api/v4/leads/{id}.

tools.name: kommo_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) with their names, custom fields (email, phone) and responsible user. One request per call. GET /api/v4/contacts.

tools.name: kommo_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with optional embedded data (leads, companies). GET /api/v4/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: kommo_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (organisations) with their names, custom fields and responsible user. One request per call. GET /api/v4/companies.

tools.name: kommo_get_company
tools.description: Get one company by id, with optional embedded data (contacts, leads). GET /api/v4/companies/{id}.

tools.name: kommo_list_tasks
tools.description: List follow-up tasks, optionally only open ones, for one user or one linked entity. One request per call. GET /api/v4/tasks.

tools.name: kommo_list_notes
tools.description: List the notes (comments, calls, status changes) of one lead, contact or company. One request per call. GET /api/v4/{entity}/{id}/notes.

tools.name: kommo_create_lead
tools.description: Create one lead (deal) in a pipeline stage. Creates a new record on every call: it does not check for duplicates. POST /api/v4/leads.

tools.name: kommo_update_lead
tools.description: Change one lead: name, value, pipeline, stage or owner. Only the given fields change. Repeating the same call gives the same result. PATCH /api/v4/leads/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kommo_list_users, kommo_list_contacts, kommo_list_notes, kommo_create_lead · Private data: kommo_list_custom_fields, kommo_get_lead, kommo_list_contacts, kommo_get_contact, kommo_get_company, kommo_list_notes, kommo_create_lead · Public sink: kommo_list_contacts, kommo_create_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kommo_list_users, kommo_list_contacts, kommo_list_notes, kommo_create_lead · Private data: kommo_list_custom_fields, kommo_get_lead, kommo_list_contacts, kommo_get_contact, kommo_get_company, kommo_list_notes, kommo_create_lead · Public sink: kommo_list_contacts, kommo_create_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
